<section_guide number="1" title="Product Overview">
<purpose>Select one Primary Persona and define the product through that user's problem and expected change.</purpose>

<questions>
1. If more than one persona is possible, which single persona is most important for this Lite PRD?
2. What should they be able to do or decide differently after using the product?
</questions>

<workflow>
When the user presents several personas, briefly name the candidates and ask the user to choose exactly one Primary Persona before drafting or saving this section. Do not choose silently and do not merge candidates into a composite persona. When one persona is already explicit, use it without reopening the choice.

Use the project name as the initial Product Name candidate. Draft the one-line summary, problem,
solution direction, and expected user change from the selected persona's perspective. Do not add a
second user segment or a solution capability the user did not confirm.
</workflow>

<completion>Confirm exactly one Primary Persona, present one approval digest covering 1.1-1.6, then save each approved subsection separately.</completion>
</section_guide>
